title: qmd status --json
description: How current and alive qmd is, per source. Times are epoch seconds (UTC). Keys not declared here are qmd internals: not part of the contract, may change without notice, and must not be read by other systems.

installed_git_sha.description: Full commit SHA stamped into the installed package by deploy.sh; null for an unstamped development package. Independent of the checkout and data home.

at.description: When the CLI computed this answer.

alive.description: ingestd's heartbeat is at most 300 s old at `at`. When false, capture has stopped and every per-source value describes the past.

heartbeat_at.description: ingestd's last heartbeat; null if never written.

state.description: The last `qmd verify` result; null if verify has not run or its result is unreadable.

red_checks.description: Names of failing checks; empty when green.

maintenance.description: Current rebuild or reparse; null when idle or unknown on an older producer. Field nulls mean unknown except source=null means a full rebuild.

stage.description: prepare, read, tombstones, swap or waiting_for_lease; null = unknown.

lease_owner.description: The qmd work holding the host heavy lock; null when waiting or the owner is unknown.

last_slice_at.description: Start of the most recent work slice; null before work begins.

last_failure_at.description: Time of the latest qmd-side outcome counted as a verify failure (including retry-exhausted transient failures and live unavailable voice notes, but never source refusals); null if none known.

last_failure.description: The same outcome that sets last_failure_at; null if none known.

reason.description: Failure category, exception class or HTTP status; null = unknown. No message content or credentials.

sources.description: One entry per source system (gmail, whatsapp, calendar, x, instapaper, fathom, files, files-archive, claude, codex, pi, gsd-events, ...).

fresh_through.description: Every item the provider had published before this time is captured or explicitly excluded (D-168). null = unknown. This is the only completeness field: never use last_complete or searchable_through for it. It does not cover items the provider publishes late with an earlier item time; enumerate with qmd.feed.v1 for that.

lag_s.description: max(0, source_head - processed_through), the native item-time ingest gap used by verify. null without a completed run or either clock. Not discovery age or at - fresh_through; exclusions count as processed, not searchable documents.

processed_through.description: Newest native item time with an ingest outcome (doc, edit, tombstone or parser exclusion). Compared with capture source_head by verify; not a completeness boundary. null = not yet known.

parser_exclusions.description: Cumulative live parser exclusions by reason; separate from capture receipt counts.

valid_until.description: Scheduled lane currency expires after this instant: fresh_through + limit_s. Consumers compare their clock to this value instead of recomputing the limit. null when currency is unknown or the lane is unscheduled; not yet required for older producers.

current.description: at <= valid_until (fresh_through + limit_s). null when fresh_through is unknown or the lane has no scheduled capture.

limit_s.description: qmd's lateness limit for this source: max(3600, 2 x cadence_s), as verify uses it.

cadence_s.description: The source's declared lane cadence, the same value verify measures lateness against (readers included, e.g. sessions 15, files 1440); null only for producer lanes with no scheduled capture (cadence 0, e.g. gsd-events).

error.description: The provider error of the latest run, or null if the latest run had none. Never carried over from an earlier run.

rate_limited.description: The latest run was cut short by the provider.
